bioconda.name: te-looker
bioconda.summary: TE-looker (dtr): de novo discovery of divergent ('twilight-zone') transposable elements (Rust).
bioconda.description:
TE-looker provides the `dtr` (Dark TE Rebuilder) CLI plus te-discover / te-refine /
te-seed helpers. It targets older, divergent TEs (D_cc 45-75%) as the Step-4 track of
the Pan_TE pipeline.
